# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class ColaPepsiPairsTradingAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(250000)

        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        self._ko = self.add_equity("KO", Resolution.MINUTE)
        self._pep = self.add_equity("PEP", Resolution.MINUTE)
        self._spread = self.spread(self._ko.symbol, self._pep.symbol, True)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._spread = Spread(self._ko.symbol, self._pep.symbol, True)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._spread)
        # self.register_indicator(self._ko, self._spread)
        # self.register_indicator(self._pep, self._spread)

        self._spread_ma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._spread_ma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._spread_ma)
        # self.register_indicator(self._spread, self._spread_ma)

        self.plot_indicator("Spread", self._spread, self._spread_ma)

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self._ko.symbol),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._ko.symbol, 30),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        if not self._spread.is_ready or not self._spread_ma.is_ready:
            return

        current_spread = self._spread.current.value
        ma_spread = self._spread_ma.current.value

        if not self._ko.invested and not self._pep.invested:
            if abs(current_spread - ma_spread) > 2.0:
                if current_spread > ma_spread:
                    self.set_holdings(self._ko, 1.0, True)
                else:
                    self.set_holdings(self._pep, 1.0, True)
        elif self._ko.invested and not self._pep.invested:
            if current_spread < ma_spread:
                self.liquidate(self._ko)
                self.set_holdings(self._pep, 1.0, True)
        elif self._pep.invested and not self._ko.invested:
            if current_spread > ma_spread:
                self.liquidate(self._pep)
                self.set_holdings(self._ko, 1.0, True)
